name: distributed_lock-batch
cmd: GDP_TD_BATCH=research/protocols/engine/picks/distributed_lock.txt timeout -s KILL 220 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 180000 --only distributed_lock --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/e.log >/dev/null; grep BATCH /tmp/e.log | cut -c1-300
